takeaways: Nemotron-Terminal-8B: 7 neurons edited (98.8% success rate with 23 training sessions)
Qwen3.6-27B: 6 neurons edited (51-99.5% success rates)
Gemma-4-31B-IT: 99.5% success rates
Requires access to model checkpoint file before deployment; no threat actors observed using technique
Nemotron-Terminal-8B: 7 neurons edited, 98.8% success rate, 23 training sessions
Technique works on Qwen3.6-27B and Gemma-4-31B-IT models

No threat actors observed using technique in the wild

summary: US prosecutors unsealed an indictment on November 11, 2026, accusing three men of orchestrating attacks on Jewish and American sites across Europe on behalf of Iran's IRGC. The campaign included arson, stabbings, and a plot targeting RAF Fairford, with live-streamed attacks coordinated via FaceTime.
takeaways: Three defendants: Mohammad al-Saadi (Kataib Hezbollah), Mohsen Mohajeri (IRGC), Mohammed Ali al-Hassani (Iraqi national)

~18 attacks/attempted attacks between March–April 2026

CVE-2026-108187: CVSS 8.1, affects versions before 7.1.5

summary: A critical authentication bypass in Xen Orchestra is being actively exploited to gain administrator access and compromise XCP-ng nodes. The flaw improperly converts authentication tokens to empty objects, allowing attackers to reuse valid tokens and achieve root-level XCP-ng takeover.
takeaways: Affects Xen Orchestra versions before 6.9.2 (stable) and 6.10.1 (latest)
Authentication token converted to empty object {}, returns first token in collection
Exploitation enables arbitrary code execution and full XCP-ng node takeover as root
Threat actor confirmed exploiting alongside zero-day requiring admin privileges
Unauthorized access not logged; no CVE assigned

summary: Attackers exploited Fortinet vulnerabilities to install PEERSTITCH, a stealthy ARM64 malware on FortiGate firewalls in a telecom organization breach. takeaways: CVE-2026-108097 rated 19/25 on Drupal risk scale enabling unauthenticated RCE
